name: tradingview-mcp
description: TradingView toolkit for AI agents: SMC/ICT scanning, chart rendering, backtesting, journal sync, Pine compile, TradingView Desktop control - plus the official TradingView MCP (quotes, screener, news, calendars, alerts, watchlists) registered side by side. Not affiliated with TradingView, Inc.

OANDA_API_KEY.title: OANDA API key
OANDA_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the OANDA OHLCV provider (free practice account at oanda.com). Stored as a secret.

TV_SESSIONID.title: TradingView sessionid cookie
TV_SESSIONID.description: Optional. Enables the opt-in `session` toolset (reads data through your TradingView account - may violate TradingView's ToS). Stored as a secret.

TV_TOOLSETS.title: Enabled toolsets
TV_TOOLSETS.description: Comma list. Default `hybrid` = data,scan,chart,backtest,pine,journal,strategy,calendar (everything the official TradingView MCP does not do, plus a calendar that also carries exchange holidays and futures rollover). `default` = public,data (unauth screener, no official server needed); `all` = everything. session/desktop are opt-in and carry ToS risk: `hybrid,session,desktop`.

TV_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
TV_READ_ONLY.description: Set to 1 to disable all write-capable tools (hard-wins over everything).

TV_MAX_BARS.title: Max bars per response
TV_MAX_BARS.description: Hard cap on bars returned by data tools (default 5000).

TV_JOURNAL_DIR.title: FX Replay journal watch-folder
TV_JOURNAL_DIR.description: Where tv_journal_scan / tv_journal_parse read CSV exports.

TV_STRATEGY_DIR.title: Declarative strategy folder
TV_STRATEGY_DIR.description: Where tv_strategy_list / tv_strategy_run read YAML strategy specs.

TV_SENTINEL_DIR.title: Sentinel run folder
TV_SENTINEL_DIR.description: Where the `sentinel` toolset writes one JSON run file per watch (default ~/.tvmcp/sentinel).

TV_CDP_URL.title: TradingView Desktop CDP URL
TV_CDP_URL.description: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9223 for the opt-in `desktop` toolset (default 9223; 9222 is usually owned by another CDP tool).

TV_DESKTOP_EXE.title: TradingView Desktop executable
TV_DESKTOP_EXE.description: Optional. Full path to TradingView.exe (or TradingView.app on macOS) for tv_desktop_launch when auto-discovery (Store package, %LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs) fails.
